id.instruksi: Baca campurannya, lalu pilih cara memisahkan yang paling tepat.
id.p-r1: Paku-paku kecil tercecer di pasir tepi sungai.
id.p-r2: Butiran pasir besi hitam tercampur pasir biasa yang kering.
id.p-r3: Air sungai keruh berlumpur ditampung di ember. Tidak ada saringan, tetapi airnya mau dipakai untuk menyiram.
id.p-r4: Ampas kopi tubruk tercampur di gelas. Tidak ada saringan.
id.p-r5: Kerikil tercampur pasir untuk adukan semen. Pasirnya harus halus.
id.p-r6: Tepung beras masih bercampur gumpalan dan butir beras yang kasar.
id.p-r7: Santan diperas dari parutan kelapa lewat kain.
id.p-r8: Air keruh dialirkan melewati lapisan ijuk, pasir, dan kerikil supaya jernih.
id.p-r9: Daun kering mengambang di air kolam dan diambil dengan jaring.
id.p-r10: Air laut ditampung di tambak supaya garamnya bisa diambil.
id.p-r11: Gula sudah larut di air. Bagaimana mendapatkan kristal gulanya kembali?
id.p-r12: Garam yang larut di air tidak tertahan kertas saring. Cara yang bisa memisahkannya adalah…

en.instruksi: Read about the mixture, then choose the best way to separate it.
en.i-endap: letting it settle, then pouring off slowly
en.p-r1: Small nails are scattered in the riverbank sand.
en.p-r2: Black iron sand is mixed with ordinary dry sand.
en.p-r3: Muddy river water is collected in a bucket. There is no filter, but the water is needed for watering plants.
en.p-r4: The grounds are mixed into a cup of coffee. There is no strainer.
en.p-r5: Gravel is mixed with sand for cement. The sand must be fine.
en.p-r6: Rice flour is still mixed with lumps and coarse grains of rice.
en.p-r7: Coconut milk is squeezed from grated coconut through a cloth.
en.p-r8: Cloudy water runs through layers of palm fibre, sand and gravel to make it clear.
en.p-r9: Dry leaves floating on pond water are scooped out with a net.
en.p-r10: Seawater is kept in salt pans so the salt can be collected.
en.p-r11: Sugar has dissolved in water. How can you get the sugar crystals back?
en.p-r12: Dissolved salt passes through filter paper. The way to separate it is…
